24702.name: On The Bridge Across The Ravine

east.description: To the east lies The Landfall Before Aredrel Dwarven.

west.description: To the west lies Before The Bridge Across The Ravine.

24702.description:
A bridge of carved stone leaps the ravine, its parapets worn smooth by
long ages of boots and weather. The iron gate at the bridge's head now
stands open, and the way runs back west toward the badlands. Far below,
a pale thread of water glints in the gorge, and the wind sings through
the gap in one low note. Ahead, east, the span ends at a broad stone
landing under the mountain's shoulder.

24703.name: The Landfall Before Aredrel Dwarven

east.description: To the east lies Along The Rocky Path.

west.description: To the west lies On The Bridge Across The Ravine.

24703.description:
The bridge ends in a vaulted landing cut straight into the mountain's
flank, where the roof is low and soot-stained from old braziers. Wet
gusts from the ravine still push through the arch behind you to the
west. Rune-carved lintels mark the way out east, and the floor is worn
into two shallow troughs by the wheels of ore carts. The air smells of
cold iron and woodsmoke.

24704.name: Along The Rocky Path

east.description: To the east lies Along The Rocky Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Landfall Before Aredrel Dwarven.

24704.description:
A rocky path winds up from the landing, a ribbon of pale gravel between
heaps of broken grey stone. Cairns of fist-sized rocks stand at the
verge, set there by dwarven hands to keep travellers from the ravine's
lip. Thin grass shivers in the wind that comes off the gorge. The path
runs on east toward the mountain, and west it drops back to the landing.

24705.name: Along The Rocky Path

east.description: To the east lies Along The Rocky Path.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Rocky Path.

24705.description:
The path narrows here between two shoulders of weathered rock, and the
gravel gives way to bedrock scored with old wheel ruts. A twisted thorn
clings to a crack in the wall, its few leaves rattling dryly. Ahead the
ridge looms, dark and bare, and somewhere beyond it a hammer rings
faintly on stone. The path leads on east, while west it runs back toward
the bridge landing.

24706.name: Along The Rocky Path

east.description: To the east lies Before The Gate Of Aredrel Dwarven.

south.description: To the south lies A Trail Through The Rocky Plains.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Rocky Path.

24706.description:
The path widens into a rough crossing of trampled gravel where a lesser
track branches away south across the rocky plain. A squat waymark of
piled stones leans at the fork, its top painted with a faded rune of
welcome. Wind-bent tufts of heather cling in the lee of the boulders.
The main path runs east to the village gate and back west along the
ravine.

24707.name: Before The Gate Of Aredrel Dwarven

east.description: To the east lies Aredrel's Gate - Entrance To The Dwarven Village.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Rocky Path.

24707.description:
A tall wall of dressed stone rises in front of the mountain, and the
great gate of Aredrel Dwarven yawns just ahead, east. Its posts are
carved with knotted beards and crossed hammers, and a lantern of green
glass hangs from a bracket, throwing an emerald glow over the cobbles.
Fine dust from many boots lies drifted against the wall. West, the rocky
path dwindles away toward the ravine.

24708.name: Aredrel's Gate - Entrance To The Dwarven Village

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Nothern Watchtower.

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Cave Of Aredrel Dwarven.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Southern Watchtower.

west.description: To the west lies Before The Gate Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24708.description:
Inside the gate stands a small paved court, ringed by squat towers whose
slit windows overlook the path. A great oaken door banded with iron
stands in the cliff face ahead, east, and the green lamplight of the
cave glows beneath it. Two stair-turrets rise at the court's edges, to
the north and to the south. West, the gate arch opens on the rocky path
outside.

24709.name: Outside The Nothern Watchtower

south.description: To the south lies Aredrel's Gate - Entrance To The Dwarven Village.

up.description: To the up lies Inside The Northern Watchtower.

24709.description:
The watchtower rises from the courtyard's corner, a stout drum of grey
stone chinked with mortar and lichen. Arrow slits stare out over the
rocky plain, and an iron-banded door at its foot stands ajar on a spiral
stair that climbs up. A rack of weathered practice staves leans against
the wall. South, the court of the gate lies open to the wind.

24710.name: Inside The Northern Watchtower

down.description: To the down lies Outside The Nothern Watchtower.

24710.description:
A round stone chamber crowns the tower, its walls pierced with narrow
embrasures that let in thin streaks of daylight. A brazier of black iron
squats in the middle of the floor, ringed with ash and the scorched
stubs of old fires. A horn of beaten brass hangs on a peg by the stair,
and a signal-lantern waits beside it. The only way out is the stair
spiralling down to the court.

24711.name: Outside The Southern Watchtower

north.description: To the north lies Aredrel's Gate - Entrance To The Dwarven Village.

up.description: To the up lies Inside The Southern Watchtower.

24711.description:
The watchtower rises out of the gate court, a squat drum of dark stone
with narrow loops for archers. Its door of iron-bound oak stands ajar
over a few worn steps, and a lamp of green glass hangs above. A barrel
catches rain from a gutter, and moss creeps up the wall. North the court
of the gate opens, and a spiral stair climbs up inside.

24712.name: Inside The Southern Watchtower

down.description: To the down lies Outside The Southern Watchtower.

24712.description:
A round chamber at the tower's crown, with a floor of worn boards and
narrow loopholes on every side. A table with a ledger and a sand-glass
stands in the middle, and a horn hangs from a hook on the wall. Draughts
whistle through the slits, carrying the smell of rain and heather. The
stair leads down to the court.

24713.name: Entrance To The Cave Of Aredrel Dwarven

east.description: To the east lies The Main Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Aredrel's Gate - Entrance To The Dwarven Village.

24713.description:
Beyond the great door the rock opens into a high hall hewn from the
living mountain, its walls veined with seams of green that glitter in
the lamplight. Pillars of uncut stone rise to a ceiling lost in shadow,
and the air is warm and smells of coal smoke and baked bread. Far down
the hall, east, a pulse of hammering carries on the draught. The oaken
door lets in the daylight from the west.

24714.name: The Main Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Western Junction Of The Main Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance To The Cave Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24714.description:
The main hallway runs on through solid rock, wide enough for two ox-
carts abreast and floored with flagstones worn hollow. Lanterns of green
glass hang from iron hooks along the walls, each one casting a pool of
emerald light across the stone. Fine veins of crystal glint in the roof
like frozen stars. The hall continues east into the heart of the
village, and west it returns to the great entrance.

24715.name: The Western Junction Of The Main Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Main Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Main Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Main Hallway.

24715.description:
Here the great hallway divides, with passages leading away north and
south into the dim stone. Worn runes cut into the corner pillar name the
districts beyond, their letters polished by countless passing hands. A
cool breath of air flows down the northern passage, while the southern
one carries a faint scent of ale and warm bread. West, the hall runs
back to the cave's entrance.

24716.name: A Bend In The Main Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Northern Junction Of The Main Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Western Junction Of The Main Hallway.

24716.description:
The hallway bends sharply here, turning from the long southward run
toward the east. The rock wall on the outside of the curve is rubbed
shiny where a thousand shoulders have brushed past. A small niche holds
a smoky oil lamp and a clay jar of spare wicks. The passage leads on
east, and south it returns to the junction.

24717.name: The Northern Junction Of The Main Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Northern Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Main Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Main Hallway.

24717.description:
Four passages meet in a round chamber of fitted stone, its ceiling a
shallow dome carved with a ring of crossed hammers. A tall pedestal in
the centre holds a lamp of green glass, its glow rippling in the
draught. The way continues east and west along the hallway, and a broad
passage leads north toward the village quarter. Scratches on the floor
mark where carts have turned.

extra_descs.ring hammers pedestal:
The ring of carved hammers on the dome's underside is the old emblem of
Aredrel, thirteen hammers for the thirteen founding clans.

24718.name: A Bend In The Main Hallway

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Junction Of The Main Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Northern Junction Of The Main Hallway.

24718.description:
The main hallway turns a hard corner here, swinging around a pillar of
living stone. The walls are streaked with rust-coloured seams, and a
trickle of moisture shines on the floor in the lamplight. Somewhere in
the distance a bell tolls once and falls silent. The passage leads south
toward the junction, and west it runs back along the hall.

24719.name: The Eastern Junction Of The Main Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Main Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies The Eastern Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Main Hallway.

24719.description:
This junction is the busiest in the hall, its floor worn into hollows
and its walls scuffed to the height of a pack. Hallways lead away north
and south around the bend, and a broad passage runs east toward the
mining district. Lamps of green glass burn in niches at each corner,
throwing long shadows. A faint rumble drifts in from deep in the
mountain.

24720.name: A Bend In The Main Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Junction Of The Main Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Junction Of The Main Hallway.

24720.description:
The main hallway turns here, curving from the junction toward the far
side of the village. Along the wall runs a gutter of dressed stone,
carrying a trickle of clear water down to some hidden cistern. The floor
is cobbled, and a hanging lamp swings slowly in the draught. The passage
leads north to the junction and west along the hall.

24721.name: The Southern Junction Of The Main Hallway

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Main Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Main Hallway.

24721.description:
Three passages meet here beneath a vaulted roof held up by a pair of
squat pillars carved with twining roots. A bench of pale stone rests
between them, and a lantern of green glass spills warm light across the
flags. The smell of baking drifts from the passage south, where the hall
runs toward the shops. East and west the hall bends away.

24722.name: A Bend In The Main Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Western Junction Of The Main Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Junction Of The Main Hallway.

24722.description:
The hall bends here beside the junction, its walls finished with smooth
plaster and a band of carved leaves. A bench of stone stands in a
recess, with a basin of clean water and a rag for travellers' hands. The
floor shows deep wear along the inner curve. North the hall returns to
the junction, and east it runs on.

24723.name: The Southern Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Junction Of The Main Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Hallway.

24723.description:
The southern hallway is lined with small niches, each holding a
statuette of some dwarf hero cast in dull bronze. The floor slopes
gently and the air carries the scent of spices and hot bread. Lamps burn
steadily from hooks high on the wall, and the plaster between them is
painted with crossed hammers. The hallway goes on south and returns
north to the junction.

24724.name: The Southern Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Southern Hallway.

24724.description:
Wheel-ruts and the prints of many boots mark this stretch of hall, which
sees the daily traffic of the village markets. A wooden signboard hangs
from a chain, its paint flaked and its letters worn to a blur. The smell
of fresh bread is stronger here. The hall carries on south toward the
shops and returns north.

24725.name: A Bend In The Southern Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Southern Hallway.

24725.description:
The hall bends here around a heavy pillar painted with a mural of laden
barrows and bargaining dwarves, its colours dulled by years of lamp
smoke. A stone basin set into the wall collects drips from a crack above
and overflows in a thin silver line to the floor. The passage leads east
and returns north along the hall.

24726.name: A Bend In The Southern Hallway

south.description: To the south lies Before The Shopping District.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Southern Hallway.

24726.description:
The hall turns again, narrow and well-swept, as the noise of the market
grows louder ahead. Strings of dried peppers and garlic hang from a rack
above the wall, rustling softly. A painted arch in the wall frames the
way south, its stonework picked out in red and gold. West the hall runs
back along the bend, and south it opens into the market.

24727.name: Before The Shopping District

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Southern Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Middle Of The Shopping District.

24727.description:
The market-hall's entrance is a wide archway hung with banners of dyed
cloth, each stitched with the sign of a trade. Barrow-ruts cross the
floor in all directions, and the smells of ale, leather and spice rise
together. Lanterns of green and amber glass swing from the beams. North
the hall runs back to its bend, and south it spreads into the market
proper.

24728.name: The Middle Of The Shopping District

north.description: To the north lies Before The Shopping District.

east.description: To the east lies The Eastern Hallway Through The Shopping District.

south.description: To the south lies The Tavern Inn Of Aredrel.

west.description: To the west lies The Western Hallway Through The Shopping District.

24728.description:
The heart of the shopping district is a broad square beneath a high
ceiling, where a well of black marble stands in the middle and the
flagstones are stained with a hundred years of spilled ale. Streets of
stalls and shopfronts spread to the east and the west, while a carved
sign marks the tavern's door to the south. Lanterns burn along the
cornices, and a shuffle of boots sounds on the floor. North the hall
returns toward the entrance arch.

24729.name: The Tavern Inn Of Aredrel

north.description: To the north lies The Middle Of The Shopping District.

south.description: To the south lies The Tavern Inn Bar of Aredrel.

24729.description:
The tavern's front room is dim and smoky, its beams hung with tin mugs
and its floor strewn with fresh rushes. Long tables of scarred oak stand
in rows, and a roaring hearth throws heat across the benches. Over the
mantel hangs a mounted ram's head with polished horns. The street lies
north, and the bar opens south.

24730.name: The Tavern Inn Bar of Aredrel

north.description: To the north lies The Tavern Inn Of Aredrel.

up.description: To the up lies The Sleeping Lodge.

24730.description:
The tavern bar is a long counter of oak, its top polished by countless
elbows, and behind it stand kegs of black ale and shelves of clay jugs.
Brass taps gleam in the lamplight, and a ring of stools surrounds the
hearth. A narrow stair of timber climbs up to the lodge above. The front
room lies north.

24731.name: The Sleeping Lodge

down.description: To the down lies The Tavern Inn Bar of Aredrel.

24731.description:
The sleeping lodge is a low, long room under the rafters, lined with
plain bunks, each made up with a grey wool blanket and a bolster. Small
lanterns hang over every bed, turned low, and the boards creak with a
sound like old timbers. A chest at each bed's foot holds a traveller's
belongings. The stair leads down to the bar.

24732.name: The Eastern Hallway Through The Shopping District

east.description: To the east lies The Eastern Shopping Square.

west.description: To the west lies The Middle Of The Shopping District.

24732.description:
A short covered hallway between shopfronts, its lintels hung with
painted signs of copper, bread and bellows. Awnings of oiled canvas
shade the narrow stalls, and a drift of straw lies on the cobbles. The
air smells of leather and warm bread. East the hall opens into a square,
and west it returns to the middle of the market.

24733.name: The Eastern Shopping Square

north.description: To the north lies The Bakery Of Aredrel.

east.description: To the east lies The Water Shop of Aredrel.

south.description: To the south lies The Jewellery Of Aredrel.

west.description: To the west lies The Eastern Hallway Through The Shopping District.

24733.description:
This small square is crowded with stalls, its centre taken up by a stone
fountain in the shape of a ram's head with a dry spout. Three shopfronts
open off it, one for baking, one for water, one for jewellery, each with
a painted board. Cobbles are slick with spilled flour and mud. The way
north, east and south leads into the shops, and west it returns to the
hall.

24734.name: The Guard Barrack Of Aredrel

south.description: To the south lies A Junction In The Village Hallway.

24734.description:
The barrack is a long low room of whitewashed stone, lined with plain
bunks and chests bolted to the floor. Racks along the walls hold hammers
and spears gone dull with use, and a table scarred by dagger-points
stands in the middle. A chart of the cave's tunnels is pinned above the
hearth, its corners curled with smoke. The only door leads south into
the village hallway.

24735.name: The Jewellery Of Aredrel

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Shopping Square.

24735.description:
A narrow, glittering shop where lamps of green glass are set to catch
the facets of the stones in the glass cases. Rings, torcs and brooches
lie on black velvet, and a magnifying lens on a tripod stands at the
counter. The shelves are crowded with small boxes of polished emeralds,
each tagged in dwarven runes. The only way out is the door north.

24736.name: The Bakery Of Aredrel

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Shopping Square.

24736.description:
The bakery is warm and floury, its low ceiling blackened with
generations of smoke. A great brick oven fills one wall, its iron door
ajar and glowing a deep orange, and wooden trays of dough sit on long
tables nearby. Loaves of black rye and honeyed buns stand in neat rows
behind a counter scarred by knives. The only door opens south onto the
square.

24737.name: The Water Shop of Aredrel

west.description: To the west lies The Eastern Shopping Square.

24737.description:
Rows of stoneware jugs and leather skins line the shelves of this shop,
each stamped with the name of a spring deep under the mountain. A barrel
with a brass tap stands on the counter, beaded with cold sweat, and a
wooden dipper hangs beside it. The floor is damp and the air cool, with
a smell of clean stone. West, a doorway returns to the square.

24738.name: The Western Hallway Through The Shopping District

east.description: To the east lies The Middle Of The Shopping District.

west.description: To the west lies The Western Shopping Square.

24738.description:
The western hallway through the shopping district is lined with narrow
doors, each painted a different colour. The ceiling is lower here, and
the lamps hang closer, so that the light is warm and golden. A crooked
sign over one doorway swings and creaks in the draught. East the hall
returns to the middle of the market, and west it widens into a square.

24739.name: The Western Shopping Square

north.description: To the north lies The Armoury Of Aredrel.

east.description: To the east lies The Western Hallway Through The Shopping District.

south.description: To the south lies The Magic Shop Of Aredrel.

west.description: To the west lies The Weapon Shop Of Aredrel.

24739.description:
This square is ringed by three smithing trades, and the clang of metal
on metal never quite stops. The flagstones are scorched with fallen
sparks, and a long water trough stands against the pillar. Racks of iron
stand beside each door, and the air carries coal-smoke and hot oil. The
armoury stands north, the magic shop south, and the weapon shop west,
while the hall returns east.

24740.name: The Magic Shop Of Aredrel

north.description: To the north lies The Western Shopping Square.

24740.description:
The magic shop is a curious, cluttered room, its shelves crammed with
stoppered bottles, bundled herbs and runed stones. A brass astrolabe
turns slowly on the counter, driven by no hand, and a faint smell of
sulphur and sage hangs in the air. Lamps burn with a pale violet flame.
A single door opens north to the square.

24741.name: The Armoury Of Aredrel

south.description: To the south lies The Western Shopping Square.

24741.description:
The armoury is hung from floor to rafters with coats of ring and scale,
helms and shields, each polished to a dull shine. A stand of plate
stands in the centre, its joints oiled and its visor open. The counter
holds a rack of file and hammer, and a mallet for knocking out dents.
The only door opens south to the square.

24742.name: The Weapon Shop Of Aredrel

east.description: To the east lies The Western Shopping Square.

24742.description:
Spears and axes hang in racks across every wall of the weapon shop,
their blades gleaming with oil. A grindstone stands in the corner, a
bucket beneath it, and a pile of rough ingots waits on the floor.
Notched practice targets stand along one wall, riddled with holes. The
door east leads back to the square.

24743.name: The Northern Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Northern Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Northern Junction Of The Main Hallway.

24743.description:
The northern hallway runs straight and narrow, its walls hewn smooth and
set with iron rings for torches. The floor slopes very gently upward,
and the air feels fresher, as if it had travelled through some hidden
shaft from the open sky. A faint trace of woodsmoke clings to the roof.
North the passage carries on, and south it returns to the junction.

24744.name: The Northern Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Northern Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Northern Hallway.

24744.description:
Long scrapes along the lower walls tell of barrels and crates dragged
this way for years. Between the lamps the stone is dark and cold, and
the quiet is broken only by the drip of water somewhere out of sight. A
line of runes, half worn away, runs along the lintel overhead. The
hallway goes on north, and south it leads back toward the main junction.

24745.name: A Bend In The Northern Hallway

south.description: To the south lies The Northern Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Northern Hallway.

24745.description:
The hallway swings here in a tight curve, the outer wall bulging where
the masons followed a vein of hard rock. A single green lantern burns
above a wooden bench no one has sat on in a long while. Cold air creeps
along the floor. West the passage bends on, and south it runs back down
the straight hall.

24746.name: A Bend In The Northern Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Before The Village District.

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Northern Hallway.

24746.description:
The passage turns north again after its long bend, and the stone here is
cleaner, the floor swept and sanded against slipping. Carved on the wall
is a bearded face with eyes of inlaid emerald, so old that the nose is
worn flat. A warm glow ahead promises the village. The way leads on
north, and east it bends back along the hall.

extra_descs.face wall emerald:
The bearded face is the founder-king, his inlaid eyes two chips of green
glass that catch every lamp.

24747.name: Before The Village District

north.description: To the north lies A Junction In The Village Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Northern Hallway.

24747.description:
The tunnel opens out into a wider antechamber at the very edge of the
village district. Painted pennants of faded wool hang from the roof
beams, each stitched with the sign of a dwarf clan. A stone trough runs
along one wall, full of sand for quenching boots and lamps. South the
passage narrows down toward the hallway, and ahead north the village
hallway begins.

24748.name: A Bend In The Village Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Along The Village Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies A Junction In The Village Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies An Aredrel Dwarven House.

24748.description:
The hallway bends here beside the crossing, where a rain-barrel stands
filled by a trickle from the rock. A rack of pegs holds heavy cloaks and
leather aprons, left for all to borrow. In the western wall a round-
topped door stands closed against the draughts. North the hallway runs
on, and east it opens back to the crossing.

24749.name: An Aredrel Dwarven House

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

24749.description:
A neat, dark little dwelling, with a long table of scrubbed oak and
benches worn smooth by generations of use. Rows of mugs hang on pegs
above the hearth, and a copper kettle ticks as it cools. A carved wooden
beard-comb sits on the mantel beside a clay pipe. The door east leads
back out to the hallway bend.

24750.name: Along The Village Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

24750.description:
A narrow straight hallway, its ceiling so low that taller travellers
must stoop beneath the lamps. The walls are hung with woven tapestries,
faded from many years in the smoke, depicting battles under a green sky.
A thin trail of sawdust marks the middle of the floor. The hallway leads
north to a corner and south to a bend.

24751.name: A Bend In The Village Hallway

east.description: To the east lies Along The Village Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Village Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies An Aredrel Dwarven House.

24751.description:
The hallway bends at a corner where two walls meet at a sharp angle, and
a small shrine to the forge-father has been set into the stone. A bowl
of cold ash and a little carved hammer lie in the niche. A door in the
western wall stands half open, letting out the sweet smell of baking.
East and south the hallway carries on.

24752.name: An Aredrel Dwarven House

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

24752.description:
A smith's family keeps this house, to judge by the small anvil on the
hearthstone and the tongs hanging by the chimney. Soot lies thick on the
beams, and the floor is gritty with iron filings swept into neat piles.
A heavy bed-chest stands under a window of green-tinted glass set in the
stone. The door east returns to the hallway bend.

24753.name: Along The Village Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Chamber Of Archives.

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

24753.description:
This stretch of hallway is quiet and dry, with shelves of scroll-cases
built into the walls on either side. A heavy door of black wood stands
to the north, studded with brass and bearing a plaque in dwarven script.
Dust gathers thickly in the corners, though the floor is carefully
swept. The hallway goes on east and west.

24754.name: The Chamber Of Archives

south.description: To the south lies Along The Village Hallway.

24754.description:
Tall shelves of dark oak run to the roof, crowded with scrolls, ledgers
and clay tablets, each in its own pigeonhole. A reading desk stands
under a green-glass lamp, with a quill and a pot of dried ink left
beside an open ledger. The room smells of vellum and old lamp oil. A
narrow door leads south to the village hallway, the only way in or out.

24755.name: A Bend In The Village Hallway

east.description: To the east lies An Aredrel Dwarven House.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Village Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Village Hallway.

24755.description:
The hallway swings here around a thick pillar of stone, its surface
carved with a long procession of bearded kings. A door of dark oak
stands set in the eastern wall, with a lamp of green glass above it,
still warm. The air hums with the thud of some distant forge. West the
hallway leads on, and south it returns to a straight run.

24756.name: An Aredrel Dwarven House

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

24756.description:
This low, snug dwelling is crammed with stout furniture made to a
dwarf's measure. A fire crackles in a stone hearth, throwing ruddy light
over a table scattered with wooden bowls, and a rack of copper pans
hangs from the beams. Rugs of coarse wool cover the flagstones, and a
ladder-backed chair sits by the fire. The only way out is the door west
to the hallway.

24757.name: Along The Village Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

24757.description:
The hallway runs straight along a row of narrow doors, their frames
carved with names in blocky runes. Pots of pale cave-mushrooms sit on
the sills, glowing a soft, sickly white. The floor is polished by years
of sweeping, and a bucket of sand stands by the wall. The hall runs on
north and returns south toward the bend.

24758.name: A Bend In The Village Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Along The Village Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies An Aredrel Dwarven House.

west.description: To the west lies A Junction In The Village Hallway.

24758.description:
The village hallway curves here, narrowing between smooth walls of pale
stone. A shuttered window set in the rock lets out the warm smell of a
cooking fire, and a brass doorknocker in the shape of a ram's head
gleams on a door in the eastern wall. Boot-scrapers of black iron stand
beside every threshold. North the hallway climbs on, and west it runs
back to the crossing.

24759.name: An Aredrel Dwarven House

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

24759.description:
This house is cramped but cheerful, its ceiling of bare rock hung with
bundles of dried herbs and strings of onions. A wide bed with a
patchwork quilt fills one corner, and a cradle of carved pine rocks
gently in the warm air. Mugs of horn and clay sit on a shelf above a
squat iron stove. The door west gives onto the village hallway.

24760.name: A Junction In The Village Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Guard Barrack Of Aredrel.

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Before The Village District.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Village Hallway.

24760.description:
Four hallways meet at the village's crossing, where the roof is high and
the floor is worn with the tread of generations. A heavy oak door bound
in iron stands in the northern wall, marked with the crossed axes of the
village guard. Hallways run away east and west, curving out of sight
beneath hanging lamps. Water gurgles in a stone gutter along the base of
the walls, and south the passage runs back toward the antechamber.

24761.name: The Eastern Hallway

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Eastern Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Eastern Junction Of The Main Hallway.

24761.description:
The eastern hallway runs between walls of rough-cut stone, cooler and
quieter than the main halls. Iron rails sunk into the floor tell of ore
carts that once rolled here by the hour. Veins of green crystal glimmer
faintly in the rock overhead. The hallway leads on east, and west it
opens to the junction.

24762.name: A Bend In The Eastern Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Eastern Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Eastern Hallway.

24762.description:
The hall turns a sharp corner as the tunnel follows a seam of hard rock,
and the air takes on a metallic tang. A rusty pick leans against the
wall, forgotten, its handle split with age. Shallow puddles lie in the
hollows of the floor, black and still. The passage runs on north, and
west it returns along the hall.

24763.name: The Eastern Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Eastern Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Eastern Hallway.

24763.description:
A straight run of tunnel, narrower than the rest, where the lamps hang
far apart and shadows pool between them. Coal-dust smears the walls at
shoulder height, and the floor is deeply grooved by the iron wheels of
carts. A cold current flows steadily past, drawing the lamp-flames
sideways. North and south the passage carries on.

24764.name: A Bend In The Eastern Hallway

east.description: To the east lies End Of The Eastern Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern Hallway.

24764.description:
Rough steps cut into the floor mark a change of level as the tunnel
curves to the east. Stout timbers prop the roof, and a rope handrail has
been looped along the wall. The distant ringing of hammers is louder
here and carries a strange, hollow note. The passage leads on east, and
south it descends to the straight tunnel.

24765.name: End Of The Eastern Hallway

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Eastern Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies Entrance To The Mining District.

24765.description:
The hall ends in a small round chamber with a wide stair spiralling down
into the earth. A great wheel of black iron stands by the stairhead,
wound with chain that disappears into the dark below. Warm air smelling
of hot metal rises from beneath. West the hallway runs back to the bend,
and the stair leads down to the mining district.

24766.name: Entrance To The Mining District

east.description: To the east lies The Mining District.

up.description: To the up lies End Of The Eastern Hallway.

24766.description:
The stair ends in a broad gallery cut into the ore-bearing rock, where
the walls glitter with flecks of green and gold. Heaps of broken stone
lie sorted by size beside a line of rusty carts. Smoke from a hundred
lamps has blackened the ceiling, and pick marks score every surface. The
gallery leads east into the diggings, and the stair climbs up behind
you.

24767.name: The Mining District

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Mining District.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance To The Mining District.

24767.description:
The mining district stretches out in a long gallery braced with squared
timbers, each one stamped with a clan-mark. Rails run down the middle of
the floor, buckled by the weight of loaded carts. Hammers ring out
ahead, sharp and quick, from some deeper seam. The gallery runs on east,
and west it leads back toward the stair.

24768.name: A Bend In The Mining District

north.description: To the north lies The Mining District.

west.description: To the west lies The Mining District.

24768.description:
The gallery bends around a great pillar left standing by the diggers,
its surface scarred with notches counting the seams taken. A crate of
spent candle-stubs and a tin lantern lie abandoned in a dusty alcove.
The air is thick with stone-dust that tickles the throat. North the
diggings continue, while west the gallery runs back toward the stair.

24769.name: The Mining District

north.description: To the north lies A Platform Over The Mining Shaft.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Mining District.

24769.description:
This stretch of the mine is wide and ragged, the rock torn open by
countless blows into a ceiling of jagged teeth. Ore carts stand tilted
on a spur of broken rail, their iron beds red with rust. A damp breath
rises from some deep opening ahead, north, where a rail of timber hangs
across the dark. Behind you, south, the gallery curves back.

24770.name: A Platform Over The Mining Shaft

south.description: To the south lies The Mining District.

down.description: To the down lies The Mining Shaft.

24770.description:
A broad platform of timber and iron hangs above the mining shaft, ringed
by a sturdy rail of oak. A cage-winch with a great drum of rope stands
at its edge, and a lamp on a chain sways over the abyss. Below, the
shaft plunges into utter blackness, and cold air rises with a faint,
stony smell. The gallery lies south, while a ladder leads down into the
shaft.

24771.name: The Mining Shaft

up.description: To the up lies A Platform Over The Mining Shaft.

down.description: To the down lies The Mining Shaft.

24771.description:
Iron rungs bolted into the rock lead down the shaft's wall, slick with
seeping water. The walls here are cut straight and true, though lichen
blooms in pale patches. Overhead, the platform's lamp is a small yellow
star, and below there is only darkness. A steady drip echoes and re-
echoes. The rungs climb up to the platform and descend deeper.

24772.name: The Mining Shaft

up.description: To the up lies The Mining Shaft.

down.description: To the down lies The Mining Shaft.

24772.description:
The shaft is narrower at this depth, and the walls close in until your
shoulders brush the cold rock. Chisel marks run in neat rows beside the
ladder, interrupted by long, ominous cracks. A foul smell of damp stone
and old smoke seeps from below. Up the rungs lies the way back, and down
they run into the dark.

24773.name: The Mining Shaft

up.description: To the up lies The Mining Shaft.

down.description: To the down lies The Mining Shaft.

24773.description:
A rotted timber brace juts from the wall, half-fallen across the shaft
and hung with a mat of grey roots. The ladder shudders when weight is
put on it, and flakes of rust fall into the gloom below. Faint, stony
sounds like slow breathing travel up from the depths. The ladder goes up
toward the light and down into the shaft.

24774.name: The Mining Shaft

up.description: To the up lies The Mining Shaft.

down.description: To the down lies A Platform In The Mining Shaft.

24774.description:
Here the shaft widens into a crude ledge where the diggers once rested,
with a bench of stacked stone and a scatter of old bones from their
meals. Scratches on the wall, deep and recent, seem too large to be pick
marks. A green glow wells up from below, faint and cold. The rungs lead
up, and down to a platform just below.

24775.name: A Platform In The Mining Shaft

north.description: To the north lies A Chamber Outside The Emerald Cave.

up.description: To the up lies The Mining Shaft.

24775.description:
A platform of massive timbers is wedged across the foot of the shaft,
bolted to the living stone with great iron pins. The air is colder and
heavy, and the green glow is stronger, spilling from a doorway cut in
the northern wall. The pit's walls above lose themselves in black, and
the rungs climb up toward them. Beyond the heavy door north lies a
guarded chamber.

24776.name: A Chamber Outside The Emerald Cave

north.description: To the north lies A Crossing Inside The Emerald Cave.

south.description: To the south lies A Platform In The Mining Shaft.

24776.description:
The door opens on a bare antechamber hewn from the mountain's deep
heart, its roof low and rough and lit by a green radiance that has no
lamp. Crystals the size of men's fists stud the walls and hum faintly.
Heavy iron rings are set in the floor where gates once stood. The
chamber runs north into the cave proper, and south returns to the shaft
platform.

24777.name: A Crossing Inside The Emerald Cave

north.description: To the north lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

east.description: To the east lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

south.description: To the south lies A Chamber Outside The Emerald Cave.

west.description: To the west lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

24777.description:
Four tunnels meet in a wide cavern, and every wall is crusted with
emerald crystal that drinks the lamplight and gives it back as a cold
green fire. The floor is smooth, ground by feet over many centuries, and
dust lies unbroken in the corners. Stalactites hang like spear-points
overhead. Passages lead away north, east and west, and south the way
returns to the antechamber.

24778.name: A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave

north.description: To the north lies A Bend Inside The Emerald Cave.

south.description: To the south lies A Crossing Inside The Emerald Cave.

west.description: To the west lies A Guard Chamber In The Emerald Cave.

24778.description:
The tunnel narrows, its walls flowing with veins of green that pulse
faintly, as if the stone had a heartbeat. An iron door is set in the
western wall, its handle polished by many hands. Droplets cling to the
crystals and fall into small basins worn in the floor. North the tunnel
bends away, and south it opens to the crossing.

24779.name: A Bend Inside The Emerald Cave

east.description: To the east lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

south.description: To the south lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

24779.description:
A sharp bend where the tunnel doubles back on itself, the walls glossy
with moisture and lined with crystal spikes. The green glow here is cold
and shifting, throwing wavering shadows across the roof. A thin crack in
the stone whispers with moving air. The tunnel leads on east, and south
it returns toward the crossing.

24780.name: A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave

north.description: To the north lies A Guard Chamber In The Emerald Cave.

east.description: To the east lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend Inside The Emerald Cave.

24780.description:
The tunnel runs level here, its walls scored by ancient tools and
glimmering with green flecks. A heavy door in the northern wall, bound
with iron, bears the mark of the old guard in rusted relief. The floor
is cracked and pitted, with shallow pools lying in the lowest hollows.
The way continues east and west along the tunnel.

24781.name: A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave

east.description: To the east lies A Dead End In The Emerald Cave.

south.description: To the south lies A Guard Chamber In The Emerald Cave.

west.description: To the west lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

24781.description:
The tunnel splits, its walls glowing with crowded emerald crystals that
throw back every light a hundred times over. A door of iron-bound oak
stands in the southern wall, scratched with warding signs. Loose stones
lie scattered across the floor, shaken from the roof. The tunnel ends in
a close chamber east, and west it leads back along the passage.

24782.name: A Dead End In The Emerald Cave

west.description: To the west lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

24782.description:
The tunnel ends in a ragged cavern where the mountain's emerald heart
lies exposed, a vast wall of green crystal rising out of sight. Great
scars mar the floor, gouged by something heavy that has dragged itself
back and forth. The air is thick, and the crystal hums with a low,
resonant note you feel in your teeth. There is no other way out but west
along the tunnel.

24783.name: A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave

east.description: To the east lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

south.description: To the south lies A Guard Chamber In The Emerald Cave.

west.description: To the west lies A Crossing Inside The Emerald Cave.

24783.description:
The tunnel runs on beneath a ceiling studded with crystal, each point
catching the glow and spilling it down in thin green threads. The air is
still and strangely warm, as if the stone itself were alive. A guard-
door of dark iron stands in the southern wall, scratched with notches
counting forgotten watches. The tunnel leads on east, and west it
returns to the crossing.

24784.name: A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave

west.description: To the west lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

24784.description:
A short dead-end tunnel where the roof comes down so low that the
crystals brush your hair. A fan of green-white veins spreads across the
end wall, and the rock beneath them has been chipped away by patient
hands. A few shards lie on the floor, glittering and untouched. The only
way out is the tunnel west.

24785.name: A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave

east.description: To the east lies A Crossing Inside The Emerald Cave.

24785.description:
The tunnel narrows and ends in a blind pocket, its roof clustered with
long crystals like the teeth of some buried beast. Gnawed bones are
heaped in a hollow, and a ragged web hangs in the corner, grey and
dusty. A thin draught carries the smell of stagnant water. The only way
out is east to the crossing.

24786.name: A Guard Chamber In The Emerald Cave

north.description: To the north lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

24786.description:
A guard chamber of heavy, square-hewn blocks, its single window an
arrow-slit that looks onto nothing but black rock. Stone benches line
the walls, each hollowed by years of sitting, and an iron bar leans in
the corner, bent as if with great force. Water has eaten stripes of
green into the plaster. The only door leads north to the tunnel.

24787.name: A Guard Chamber In The Emerald Cave

east.description: To the east lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

24787.description:
A narrow chamber hacked from the rock, where a long bench runs under a
row of rusted peg-hooks and a single squat brazier. The air is stale,
and the crystal in the walls has turned a murky, smoky green. A dwarven
helm lies crushed under the bench, old and forgotten. The door east
leads out to the tunnel.

24788.name: A Guard Chamber In The Emerald Cave

south.description: To the south lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

24788.description:
A guard chamber carved square from the stone, with a sentry bench and a
rack for pikes along one wall. Iron lamp-hooks hang empty from the
ceiling, and a table of black stone stands bolted in the middle. The
floor is dusted with old ash, and the walls drip steadily with green-
stained water. The only way out is the door south into the tunnel.

24789.name: A Guard Chamber In The Emerald Cave

north.description: To the north lies A Tunnel Inside The Emerald Cave.

24789.description:
This guard chamber has been wrecked in some long-ago struggle: the bunks
are splintered, the shields are dented flat, and a toppled pike rack
lies across the doorway. Dark stains mark the stone, and the green glow
from the walls makes them look black. A cold draught moves around the
edges of the room. The only door leads north back into the tunnel.

24790.name: A Trail Through The Rocky Plains

north.description: To the north lies Along The Rocky Path.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24790.description:
A faint trail winds south across the stony plain, marked by cairns of
weathered rocks. Coarse grass and thistles struggle between the
boulders, and the wind carries a smell of cold earth. To the north the
rocky path stands out as a pale line, and ahead the trail slopes toward
a low wall.

24791.name: Outside The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven

north.description: To the north lies A Trail Through The Rocky Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24791.description:
A low wall of grey stone encloses the graveyard, its gate a heavy door
of black oak studded with iron nails. An arch above is carved with a
hammer and a mourning branch, worn nearly smooth. The ground here is
bare and trodden hard, and a stone bench stands beside the gate. The
door leads north to the trail, while south the ground opens onto the
graves.

24792.name: The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven

east.description: To the east lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24792.description:
The westernmost reaches of the burial ground are scattered with small
cairns, piled by hand over graves without names. Lichen paints the
stones orange and grey, and a stunted rowan leans over the nearest, its
berries shrivelled on the branch. The silence is heavy. The path returns
east to the crossing.

24793.name: The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven

west.description: To the west lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24793.description:
The path ends at a line of old graves set against the wall, their
headstones leaning like crooked teeth. Moss has crept over the carved
names until only a few runes can be read, and a withered wreath of
heather lies at the foot of one. A raven's feather lies in the grass,
black and glossy. The only path leads west back to the crossing.

24794.name: The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven

east.description: To the east lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24794.description:
A forgotten corner where the earth has sunk, leaving shallow hollows
over the oldest graves. A small stone angel, headless, kneels beside a
pool of rainwater, and thistles crowd round it. The wind makes a thin
keening sound among the broken stones. The only path leads east back to
the nearest crossing.

24795.name: The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven

east.description: To the east lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24795.description:
Rows of narrow graves, each marked by a flat stone, fill this sheltered
corner against the wall. Candle-stubs, burnt black, stand at the foot of
a few, and a clay cup of dried flowers has fallen on its side. A cold,
damp smell rises from the earth. The path leads east, and no other way
goes from here.

24796.name: The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

east.description: To the east lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

south.description: To the south lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

west.description: To the west lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24796.description:
The graveyard's heart is a trodden crossing of four paths between rows
of squat headstones, each carved with a hammer or a pick. A cold grey
light falls from the sky, and the wind hisses through the dry grass
between the graves. A tall cairn of white stones stands at the middle,
hung with rusted chains. The gate lies north, and paths lead east, south
and west among the dead.

24797.name: The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven

west.description: To the west lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24797.description:
The easternmost corner of the graveyard is a small plot walled in by
tumbled stones, where the ground is soft and weedy. A single great slab,
flat and unmarked, lies in the middle, split down its length by a root.
Dead lilies hang from a rusted iron urn, and a chill sits on the air.
The path returns west to the crossing.

24798.name: The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven

north.description: To the north lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

east.description: To the east lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

south.description: To the south lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

west.description: To the west lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24798.description:
A wider space among the graves, where four paths meet beneath a bare
thorn tree whose branches claw at the sky. The headstones here are tall
and finely cut, carved with the ram's head of an old clan. Fallen leaves
drift against them, brown and brittle. Paths lead away north, east,
south and west among the stones.

24799.name: The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven

north.description: To the north lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

east.description: To the east lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

west.description: To the west lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

24799.description:
The graves here lie in long, neat rows, as if the dead had been buried
in ranks to serve their kings. Iron lamps on tall posts stand at each
corner, cold and blackened, and a thin mist clings to the ground. Mounds
of fresh earth have been scraped aside by something. Paths lead north to
the crossing, east toward a sunken stair, and west among the older
graves.

224800.name: The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven

west.description: To the west lies The Graveyard Of Aredrel Dwarven.

down.description: To the down lies Entrance To The Lost Crypt.

224800.description:
At the end of the path a wide stair of weathered stone yawns in the
ground, its steps leading down into utter dark. The mouth is framed by a
squat arch carved with a skull and a hammer, and the grass around it is
bent and bare. A cold breath rises from below, smelling of old stone and
dust. The stair leads down to the Lost Crypt, and west the path returns
to the graves.

650100.name: dwarf villager aredrel dwarven
650100.long_desc: A stout dwarf villager goes about the day's errands with a basket on one arm.
650100.description:
A broad, bearded dwarf in a leather apron, his hands scarred from the
forge and the mine. He eyes strangers with plain, unhurried curiosity.

650101.name: emerald cave spider
650101.long_desc: An emerald cave spider clings to the crystal wall, its hairy legs glittering green.
650101.description:
A spider as big as a hound, its carapace flecked with green crystal. Its
eyes shine like wet gems, and its fangs drip a pale, glassy venom.

650102.name: restless dwarf skeleton
650102.long_desc: A restless dwarf skeleton shambles between the graves, rusted mail hanging from its ribs.
650102.description:
The bones of a long-dead dwarf, still clad in the remnants of a mail
shirt and a cracked helm. Green light burns in its empty sockets, and
its jaw clacks silently.

650103.name: stone ogre shaft
650103.long_desc: A stone-skinned shaft ogre lumbers through the dark, dragging a mattock of iron.
650103.description:
A hulking ogre whose hide has hardened into grey plates of rock. Crystal
splinters jut from its shoulders, and it breathes in slow, rasping
gusts.

650104.name: grave bound ghost dwarven
650104.long_desc: A grave-bound dwarven ghost drifts between the headstones, its beard stirring in a wind that does not blow.
650104.description:
The pale, translucent shape of a dwarf in funeral armour, its face fixed
in grief. Cold green flame wavers about its hands.

650105.name: kharn ironvein captain guard overseer
650105.short_desc: Kharn Ironvein, captain of the shaft guard
650105.long_desc: Kharn Ironvein, captain of the shaft guard, stands over the platform with a heavy pick in both hands.
650105.description:
A scarred, grey-bearded dwarf guard in plate blackened by long use.
Green crystal has crept up his left arm, and his eyes burn with an
unnatural light.

650106.name: karrak stone troll horror
650106.short_desc: Karrak, the stone troll of the deep shaft
650106.long_desc: Karrak, the stone troll of the deep shaft, squats in the green glow and watches with slow, heavy eyes.
650106.description:
A towering troll of living rock, its body veined with glowing emerald
and its fists like boulders. The crystal in its chest pulses with a slow
heartbeat, and the floor trembles at each breath.

750100.name: spider silk wraps wrist
750100.short_desc: a pair of green spider-silk wraps
750100.room_desc: A pair of green spider-silk wraps lies here.
750100.description: Wristwraps woven from the cave spiders' glassy thread, light and tough. They shimmer faintly green.

750101.name: grave warden mail dwarven
750101.room_desc: A rusted dwarven mail shirt lies here.
750101.description: A heavy mail shirt of dwarven make, eaten with rust yet still sound. A hammer and mourning branch are stamped on the breast.

750102.name: stonefist gauntlets stone hands
750102.room_desc: A pair of heavy stonefist gauntlets lies here.
750102.description: Gauntlets of grey stone plates bound with iron wire, cold and unyielding. They make a fist like a hammerhead.

750103.name: ironvein pick mattock
750103.room_desc: A heavy ironvein pick lies here.
750103.description: A long-hafted pick of dark iron shot through with veins of green crystal. Its point is keen enough to split rock.

750104.name: emerald heart greathelm helm
750104.description: A great dwarven helm of black steel, crowned with a shard of glowing emerald. It hums softly when worn.
